[Superdrug Mobile](https://www.superdrugmobile.com/) operates as a Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in the UK running directly on the [Three](https://www.three.co.uk/) network. It provides flexible, contract-free SIM-only deals paired with health and beauty perks for shoppers. [](https://www.superdrugmobile.com/)

- **Host Network:** Uses Three's infrastructure, offering 4G and 5G coverage across roughly 97% of the UK population.

- **Features:** Includes 5G access at no extra cost, Wi-Fi calling, and tethering/personal hotspot capabilities. [](https://www.superdrugmobile.com/)

### Plan Features & Perks

- **No Contracts:** All plans operate on a rolling 30-day, contract-free basis.

- **Data Rollover:** Unused data automatically rolls over to the next calendar month.

- **Health & Beautycard Rewards:** Members get double points on Superdrug shopping and points back equivalent to portions of their plan costs.

- **EU Roaming:** Includes free roaming up to a 12GB fair usage limit when traveling in the EU. [](https://www.superdrugmobile.com/)

What You Won't Find at Superdrug
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Real-time interstitial glucose sensor patches (such as FreeStyle Libre or Dexcom) are generally obtained via pharmacies, hospitals, or specialized diabetes diabetes care networks.
Wearable ECG & Smartwatches:
Consumer smartwatches with ECG or advanced sleep tracking are sold by mainstream electronics retailers rather than high street chemists.
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Clinical-grade cellular or Bluetooth remote telemetry setups are managed directly through healthcare providers or specialized telehealth organizations.
